clue.text: One's applied for a job in the beauty business

definitions.text: One's applied for a job in the beauty business

parts.words: One's applied for a job in the beauty business
parts.note: reads like a job applicant at a salon, but means something smeared on the face as a beauty treatment

explanation.surface: A hopeful candidate applies for work at a beauty salon.
explanation.definitionFit: A face treatment of clay is literally applied to the skin by beauticians, so it is applied in the beauty trade.

clue.text: Jellyfish made us twitchy

indicators.note: twitchy suggests jerky, restless movement, so the letters of the two words before it are jumbled

explanation.surface: A jellyfish encounter left us nervous and jumpy.
explanation.definitionFit: In zoology the free-swimming bell-shaped stage of a jellyfish is called by this name.

clue.text: Fool's given up musical for a life of luxury

indicators.note: in a down clue, given up means the word is set upwards, so it reads backwards

parts.note: a clod is a dull, stupid fool
Evita is the Lloyd Webber musical about Eva Peron

explanation.surface: A foolish person abandons a stage show in favour of high living.
explanation.walkthrough: 'given up' turns CLOD to DOLC, since a down answer is read upwards.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian phrase means 'the sweet life', an existence of pleasure and indulgence.

clue.text: A girl's excited about European city

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the jumbled letters go round the other piece
excited suggests agitated and stirred up, so the letters of a girl's are thrown about

explanation.surface: A thrilled young woman tours a continental capital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'excited' makes ALGIRS from A GIRLS; 'about' puts it round E.
explanation.definitionFit: The capital of Algeria is a North African port city.

clue.text: Vital factor I neglected for uncooked shellfish

indicators.note: one letter is dropped and something else takes its place, so neglected for marks a swap

parts.note: a kingpin is the essential element on which everything depends
the letter I as written
uncooked means raw

explanation.surface: Ignoring a key element, someone ends up with raw seafood.
explanation.walkthrough: 'neglected for' swaps the I in KINGPIN for RAW.
explanation.definitionFit: A large prawn species is sold under this name, a type of crustacean.

clue.text: Naval hardware performs better than Browning

parts.note: to cap is to outdo or surpass
tan is the browning of skin in the sun

explanation.surface: Someone outdoes the poet Robert Browning in a comparison of verse.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Browning' poses as the poet; it means suntan.
explanation.definitionFit: A rotating drum on a ship's deck for winding cable is fitting kit on a vessel.

clue.text: Having no record of family touring East

indicators.note: touring means going round, so one piece is placed around the other

parts.note: a clan is an extended family

explanation.surface: A family on a trip around the Orient leaves no trace behind.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone with no convictions is said to have a spotless criminal history.

clue.text: Plain food cooked in right manner? On the contrary

indicators.note: in, flipped by the phrase that follows, signals one piece going inside another
this reverses the surface instruction, so the second piece goes inside the first rather than the other way

parts.note: a pie is food that has been baked
an air is a manner or bearing

explanation.surface: Simple food prepared the correct way.
explanation.walkthrough: Read plainly, the surface says food goes inside right manner; 'On the contrary' flips that, so it is the manner piece that sits inside the food.
explanation.definitionFit: A grassy flatland, especially in North America, is a broad expanse of open level ground.

clue.text: One wanted to spell mañana properly

definitions.text: One wanted to spell mañana properly

parts.words: One wanted to spell mañana properly
parts.note: the wavy mark over the n in the Spanish word is needed for correct spelling

explanation.surface: Someone who wants to spell the Spanish word for tomorrow correctly.
explanation.definitionFit: The diacritic over the Spanish n is exactly what correct spelling of the word requires.

clue.text: Present answer to riddle: "My middle may define my all

definitions.text: Present answer to riddle: "My middle may define my all

parts.words: Present answer to riddle: "My middle may define my all
parts.note: the two central letters of the word are AD, the era label that itself describes the present time

explanation.surface: A riddle whose solution is a word whose middle explains the whole.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle two letters are AD, anno domini, which marks the present era.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means in the present time, these days.

clue.text: Consistent effort where one was coached in history

definitions.text: where one was coached in history
definitions.meaning: a public stagecoach of past centuries, in which travellers rode

explanation.surface: Steady work, as when a pupil was tutored in history.
explanation.walkthrough: 'coached' looks like tutoring; it means riding in a coach, the old French-style stagecoach.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means persevering industry, and was also the name for a horse-drawn public coach.

clue.text: Look after silver, originally while shining

indicators.note: after places the look word behind the silver piece

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
lo is an old word meaning look

indicators.note: originally means at the start, so the first letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Polish the silverware till it gleams.
explanation.definitionFit: Glowing with light or colour, radiant.

clue.text: Lay this to capture herons?

definitions.meaning: an army surrounds a town to take it, laying a blockade
a group of herons is called by this collective noun

explanation.surface: Set a trap to catch some wading birds.
explanation.walkthrough: The collective noun for herons is the same as the word for a military blockade.
explanation.definitionFit: One sense is a military blockade; the other is the collective term for a flock of these birds.

clue.text: Correspondent noted "The Swan" introducing half-day closing

parts.note: a pen is a female swan
Fri is half the letters of the day name Friday
end means closing

explanation.surface: A pub called The Swan was noted for shutting early.
explanation.walkthrough: 'The Swan' looks like a pub name but is the female bird.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone you exchange letters with regularly, often abroad, is a correspondent.

clue.text: In the event, revision very soon slowed down

definitions.text: In the event, revision very soon slowed down

parts.words: In the event, revision very soon slowed down
parts.note: at a sporting event, a review of the action shown almost at once, often in slow motion

explanation.surface: As it turned out, the rewrite soon lost pace.
explanation.walkthrough: 'In the event' seems to mean 'as it turned out'; here it is a sporting event.
explanation.definitionFit: Television reruns a moment of play right away, often at reduced speed, for viewers to review.

clue.text: Artist's welcoming expression of pleasure for islanders

indicators.note: welcoming means taking in, so one piece holds the other

parts.note: Titian was the Venetian painter; the possessive gives TITIANS
ah is a cry of pleasure

explanation.surface: A painter greets someone with a happy sigh.
explanation.definitionFit: People native to the largest island of French Polynesia, which Gauguin painted.

clue.text: Help to advance a particular part of deal

parts.note: to advance money is to lend it
at cards, each player's share of the deal is a hand

explanation.surface: Assistance is given towards one specific part of a business deal.
explanation.walkthrough: 'deal' looks like a business deal; it is dealing cards.
explanation.definitionFit: To assist someone is the idiom of pitching in with a helping limb.

clue.text: Starts to laugh as a result

parts.note: offs are starts, as in a race being off
a hoot is a laugh

explanation.surface: Someone begins giggling because of something.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that develops from another thing is a by-product or consequence.

clue.text: Climb into apartment with female, interrupted by dad? It won't happen again!

indicators.note: into places the climbing word inside the flat word

parts.note: a flat is an apartment
to shin is to climb

indicators.note: interrupted by means another piece breaks into this one

parts.note: a hen is a female bird
pa is dad

explanation.surface: Someone scales a wall into a flat with a woman, only to be disturbed by father.
explanation.walkthrough: 'into' puts SHIN in FLAT: FLASHINT; 'interrupted by' puts PA in HEN.
explanation.definitionFit: A brief success that is never repeated is a one-off fizzle, like a misfire of an old musket.

clue.text: Plucky individual, playing like an angel?

definitions.text: Plucky individual, playing like an angel?

parts.words: Plucky individual, playing like an angel?
parts.note: plucky means brave but here means plucking strings, and angels are pictured with that instrument

explanation.surface: A brave person who performs heavenly music.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Plucky' looks like brave; it means one who plucks strings.
explanation.definitionFit: A musician who plucks the strings of the instrument angels are traditionally shown with.

clue.text: Scientist suggested grazing land needs minor modification

indicators.note: a minor modification is a small shift, so one letter of the word is moved

parts.note: pasture is grazing land

explanation.surface: Someone proposed that the field needs slight changes.
explanation.walkthrough: 'needs minor modification' moves the last E of PASTURE up a place.
explanation.definitionFit: Louis Pasteur was the French chemist behind pasteurisation and vaccines.

clue.text: As service used to be by river, expected to be held up

indicators.note: held means kept inside, so one piece sits within the river name

parts.note: the Fal is a river in Cornwall, south-west England

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means reading upwards, so the word is reversed

parts.note: due means expected

explanation.surface: Service by a riverside used to be expected to be delayed.
explanation.walkthrough: In a down answer 'up' means read upwards; 'by' is only a link. The Fal is a Cornish river.
explanation.definitionFit: Under the medieval manorial system, tenants owed labour and military duty to their lord.

clue.text: Root around for a sweetener

parts.note: root around looks like rummaging, but it means a root crop that is grown for its sugar

explanation.surface: Rummaging about in search of some sugar.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Root around' looks like rummage; it is a root crop.
explanation.definitionFit: A root vegetable farmed to extract sucrose is a source of sweetness.

clue.text: Question mode of cooking

explanation.surface: Asking how something was cooked.
explanation.definitionFit: It means to interrogate intensely, and also to cook under a heat source.

clue.text: No one's content to be so

definitions.text: No one's content to be so

parts.words: No one's content to be so
parts.note: content looks like satisfied but means contents: something with nothing inside

explanation.surface: Nobody is happy to be in this state.
explanation.walkthrough: 'content' looks like happy; read it as contents.
explanation.definitionFit: Something whose contents amount to nobody and nothing is vacant.

clue.text: Own son'll start to do this

definitions.text: Own son'll start to do this

indicators.note: start places the son letter at the front of the word

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
to own is to have

explanation.surface: A boy will one day begin to scrape his chin.
explanation.definitionFit: A son reaching adolescence begins to remove facial hair with a razor.

clue.text: Single writer recalled type of antelope

indicators.note: recalled read as called back, so the word runs backwards

parts.note: a biro is a ballpoint pen
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: A lone author remembered a kind of antelope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'recalled' turns BIRO to ORIB.
explanation.definitionFit: A small African grassland gazelle-like animal with straight horns.

clue.text: One prepared for examination to sit, taking a course

definitions.text: One prepared for examination to sit, taking a course

parts.words: One prepared for examination to sit, taking a course
parts.note: sounds like a student sitting an exam, but describes a card read by diners to find their seat at a meal of courses

explanation.surface: A student ready to sit an exam while enrolled on a course.
explanation.walkthrough: 'examination' and 'course' suggest study; it is a dinner table with courses.
explanation.definitionFit: A named card at a dinner table shows each guest where they should sit.

clue.text: Writer put back scheduled time to start play

indicators.note: to start places the turned word at the front
put back means turned back to front

parts.note: a slot is a scheduled time
to toy is to play

explanation.surface: An author postpones the timetabled start of his play.
explanation.walkthrough: 'put back' turns SLOT into TOLS.
explanation.definitionFit: Leo Tolstoy was the Russian novelist of War and Peace.

clue.text: Sweet daughter in Ulster on a trip

indicators.note: in puts the daughter letter inside the jumbled letters
on a trip suggests travelling or tripping up, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A daughter travelling in Northern Ireland.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on a trip' makes STRUEL from ULSTER; D goes in. Ulster is Northern Ireland.
explanation.definitionFit: A pastry dessert of layered dough rolled round fruit is a pudding.
